business_summary: Lantern Pharma Inc. focuses on the discovery and development of oncology drug in India. Its product pipeline comprises LP-300, which is in phase 2 clinical trial in combination therapy for never-smokers with non-small cell lung cancer adenocarcinoma; LP-184, which is in phase 1a clinical trial for the treatment of advanced or metastatic solid tumors, or unresectable or recurrent GBM, solid tumor, such as pancreatic, breast, bladder, and lung cancers, as well as glioblastoma and other central nervous system (CNS) cancers; and LP-284, which is in phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of non-Hodgkin's lymphomas, including mantle cell lymphoma and double hit lymphoma. The company also develops STAR-001, which is in preclinical development for the treatment of glioblastoma, brain metastases, atypical teratoid rhabdoid tumors, and several rare pediatric CNS cancers. In addition, it provides ADC program, an antibody drug conjugate therapeutic approach for cancer treatment. The company has a strategic AI-driven collaboration with Oregon Therapeutics to optimize the development of its first-in-class protein disulfide isomerase inhibitor drug candidate XCE853 in novel and targeted cancer indications; a collaboration agreement with TTC Oncology, which focuses on the drug development of TTC-352 to treat patients with metastatic ER+ breast cancer; and a collaboration agreement with Actuate Therapeutics, Inc. that focuses on the development of compounds for use in the treatment of cancer and inflammatory diseases leading to fibrosis. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Dallas, Texas.
business_summary_ko: Lantern Pharma Inc.는 인도의 종양학 약물 발견 및 개발에 중점을 두고 있습니다. 제품 파이프라인은 비소세포폐암 선암종을 앓고 있는 비흡연자를 위한 병용요법으로 임상 2상 시험 중인 LP-300; 진행성 또는 전이성 고형 종양, 절제 불가능하거나 재발성 GBM, 췌장암, 유방암, 방광암 및 폐암과 같은 고형 종양뿐만 아니라 교모세포종 및 기타 중추신경계(CNS) 암의 치료를 위한 1a상 임상 시험 중인 LP-184; 및 맨틀 세포 림프종 및 이중 히트 림프종을 포함한 비호 지킨 림프종 치료를위한 1 상 임상 시험이 진행중인 LP-284. 이 회사는 또한 교모세포종, 뇌 전이, 비정형 기형 횡문근 종양 및 여러 희귀 소아 CNS 암 치료를 위해 전임상 개발 중인 STAR-001을 개발하고 있습니다. 또한 암 치료를 위한 항체약물접합체 치료 접근법인 ADC 프로그램도 제공한다. 회사는 신규 및 표적 암에 대한 동급 최초의 단백질 이황화물 이성화효소 억제제 후보 XCE853의 개발을 최적화하기 위해 Oregon Therapeutics와 AI 중심의 전략적 협력을 체결했습니다.
